# Every package pinned, dependencies too, so that a fresh venv rebuilds the packs byte for
# byte (wordfreq's data and its tokenizer decide which words exist). Made with Python 3.9.6.
# The hashes (of every file PyPI has for each version, from its JSON API) make pip check
# what it downloads, as fetch_sources.sh does for the word lists.
